_comment: Evolution-loop configuration. The quality weights live here (not in engine.js READING_RULES) so the agent — which may edit READING_RULES — can never retune its own exam. Change these by hand to tell the loop which failure mode it currently cares about. `routing` (Phase 4) scores routes/resolutions by the engine's own witness degree (EOAudit.truthfulness) over a multi-turn conversation — the loop raises it by tuning the evolvable binding guards (chat_field_mass, binding_conf_*, binding_ambiguous_margin) or proposing binding_resolution ON, never by touching the grounder.
_frugality: Token guards for the experimental phase. tokenMax is the PRIMARY governor: the live agent tracks input+output tokens across all calls (hypotheses, engine probes, rubric) and the run PAUSES and asks for confirmation to continue once it is reached — set the cap small and extend deliberately. apiCallBudget is a secondary hard ceiling on call count. maxProbeRounds bounds how many times the agent may ingest a doc / ask the engine a question before it must propose. integrationSampleSize bounds how many 2c fixtures get a live rubric; maxRubricDocChars truncates the source sent to the judge; scoreTalkerLive is off (the talker LLM would double call volume). The default run is offline and spends zero tokens; the live agent ASKS for the API key if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset.
